# Custom plush manufacturers

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate.mjs from data/manufacturers.csv. Do not edit by hand. -->

55 custom plush manufacturers, grouped by country. Search, filter and compare them on **[PlushSource](https://plushsource.com)**, where each listing has a written profile and its verification date.

Facts only, taken from each manufacturer's own public pages. Empty cells mean the manufacturer does not publish that fact. A listing is not an endorsement. Last updated 2026-10-26. Data licence: [CC BY 4.0](data/LICENSE), attribution to [PlushSource](https://plushsource.com).

Want to add or correct a manufacturer? See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
